Am I glad to see you're safe!"
13. turn 314 · RUSTURF TUNNEL (map 24/4) · at 13,5 · EXPERT_M (sprite kind, not a name): "PEEKO owes her life to you!"
14. turn 314 · RUSTURF TUNNEL (map 24/4) · at 13,5 · EXPERT_M (sprite kind, not a name): "They call me MR. BRINEY.

15. turn 314 · RUSTURF TUNNEL (map 24/4) · at 13,5 · EXPERT_M (sprite kind, not a name): "… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …"
16. turn 314 · RUSTURF TUNNEL (map 24/4) · at 13,5 · EXPERT_M (sprite kind, not a name): "Ah, so you are RED!
I sincerely thank you!"
17. turn 314 · RUSTURF TUNNEL (map 24/4) · at 13,5 · EXPERT_M (sprite kind, not a name): "Now, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!"
18. turn 314 · RUSTURF TUNNEL (map 24/4) · at 13,5 · EXPERT_M (sprite kind, not a name): "You can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS."
19. turn 314 · RUSTURF TUNNEL (map 24/4) · at 13,5 · EXPERT_M (sprite kind, not a name): "Come, PEEKO, we should make our way
home."
20. turn 314 · RUSTURF TUNNEL (map 24/4) · at 13,5 · EXPERT_M (sprite kind, not a name): "PEEKO: Pihyoh!"
